verdict.rationale: The evidence documents general alerting: alerts on log patterns, alerts created from dashboard panels, and notifications on monitored signals. Nothing in the pack mentions SLO definitions, error budgets, or burn-rate alerting. Generic threshold alerts are an adjacent feature, not SLO support, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts
